data.summary_en: To stabilize experience curation in agent-written playbooks, we propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), randomly including/excluding experience blocks and task-success-based playbook selection; average success rate reaches 66.9 across two memory systems, three models, and three benchmarks—above 55.5 (full playbook), 54.1 (no playbook), and 53.8 (agent-selected).
